contribution_policy.source: An in-repo wrapper target; the header is upstream's, from the stb port.

variants.name: default
variants.description: stb_truetype from the stb port that the public map's stb-image already brings in. third_party/stb-truetype defines the stb::truetype target over the port's header, and the allocation binding compiles the implementation once.

allocation.install_before: the translation unit that defines STB_TRUETYPE_IMPLEMENTATION compiles: the macros are read there

build-flags.consumer_flags: Exactly one translation unit defines STB_TRUETYPE_IMPLEMENTATION, with the allocation macros; the others include stb_truetype.h for its declarations.
